bio:
Liza founded The Pet Studio in 2000 and has spent more than 26 years building her experience as a professional groomer, teacher and assessor. Her passion for dogs is matched by her enthusiasm for helping people develop practical skills and rewarding careers.

Whether she is grooming in the salon, supporting a nervous dog or teaching within the Academy, Liza brings energy, patience and a deep understanding of both dogs and people. Her aim is always the same: to provide exceptional care, maintain the highest professional standards and help every owner or student feel supported.
